data.content_ref: inline:The threshold-placement rule of SRC_010 depends on SRC_009's admissible-enrichment framing: assigning bounded integer weights is an admissible enrichment that adds one auxiliary attacker per weight unit, so τ strictly exceeding the weight of every root-incident attack edge is exactly the condition that no enrichment adds an attacker to a committed root. Refuted if there is a weighted attack graph where τ exceeds all root-edge weights yet some monotone enrichment consistent with the weights adds an attacker to a committed root without exceeding τ.
